paite: Mihai in alungtang in, Pathian a-om kei, achi nak hi. Ase khin ua, thil thulim lou kihhuaitak ahih uh; kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh.
heading: David La / Mite Gitlouhna / (Sam 14)

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong himhim a-om uhiam chih thei ding in Pathian in van a kipan mihing tate a-ensuk a.
Alehngat chiat ua; nintak in ana om vekta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei uh.
Thil hihkhialte'n theih anei kei ua hia! Tanghou nek bang in ka mite ane khin ua, Pathian lah asam kei uhi.
Launa omlouhna ah alau petpet ua, Pathian in nang hon umpa guhte adalhsak ziak in; Pathian in amau amuhsit ziak in, amau na zahlaksak.
Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawtleh aw! Pathian in ami saltangte a pikik nawn chiang in, huai hun chiang in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipak ding uhi.
